method: Reopened recipe source URLs in live public Craft of Exile UI via browser; read selected requirements and newly computed Calculations panel. No production data, game transactions, purchases or sales changed.

conditionalSimulation.scope: Speed tier2-or-better without vacancy (112 expected sets)
conditionalSimulation.action: Simulate this outcome in public CoE UI, stops after first qualifying result
conditionalSimulation.interpretation: A qualifying premium core can have all suffixes full. Trigger is not automatically attainable for a 3chaos finishing charge. No empirical frequency inferred from this one conditional outcome.

comparisonFindings.finding: Current12-set model stops at bare+2 and requires no speed or trigger; premium listing prices cannot establish expected realization of this output distribution.
comparisonFindings.recommendation: Retain correctly scoped cost and comparator asks; withhold derived profit/ROI until output valuation is verified. Do not substitute counterfactual attempts without defining a new explicit craft route.

comparisonFindings.finding: Required fracture20 speed,83+ essence damage,+1minion,open suffix and paidTrigger are modeled. Observed62% minion crit and spell/mana on cheapest listing are optional random extras absent from the target/probability predicate.
comparisonFindings.limitation: This reviewer did not independently reprice the optional extras; no evidence supports changing194 to represent them.

comparisonFindings.finding: T1support pair and open prefix are jointly modeled; 45500Wild plus one4chaos bench is consistent. All8-10AoE finishes are accepted; no exact10 retry is costed.

limits: CoE is the calculator primary source, not independent game-frequency evidence.
Displayed probabilities and attempts are rounded; this review does not certify underlying CoE algorithm.
Counterfactual5,564,331-result is an observed calculator value, not an empirical simulation estimate; no long simulation of that route was performed.
No practical Annul/recovery route or restart expectation was modeled.
No proof of completed sales, bulk purchase execution, gold cost, player time or profit.
No source checkout files or live runtime/data were changed.
